```yaml
name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  pre-checkout-cleanup:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black isort pytest

      - name: Run Pre-Checkout Cleanup Script
        run: |
          # Ensure we have proper permissions
          chmod +x ./scripts/fix-runner-permissions.sh
          ./scripts/fix-runner-permissions.sh

      - name: Verify Python Cache Prevention
        run: |
          # Check that Python cache prevention is properly configured
          if [ ! -f "pytest.ini" ]; then
            echo "pytest.ini not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE is set
          if [ "$PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE" != "1" ]; then
            echo "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE not set to 1"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Run Linting and Formatting
        run: |
          # Run black and isort checks
          black --check .
          isort --check-only .

      - name: Run Tests
        run: |
          # Run tests with cache disabled
          pytest --cache-clear

      - name: Security Scan
        run: |
          # Run security checks
          pip install bandit
          bandit -r . -f json -o bandit-report.json || true

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          # Clean up any temporary files
          find . -type f -name "*.pyc" -delete
          find . -type d -name "__pycache__" -exec rm -rf {} +
          rm -rf .pytest_cache/
```
